<!--
  PMS 1.43.5 GET /library/sections/{key}/all?type=2&includeGuids=1&push=1&viewedLeafCount!=0&or=1&unwatched=0&pop=1
  against a SHOW library, owner token. Recorded 2026-10-30 from a real server (plex-safety rule 11) for
  issue #173. Three rows cut from the 547 returned, one of each shape. Titles, ratingKeys, guids and
  ids are sanitised, every timestamp is shifted by one constant (order and gaps survive), and artwork,
  summary and rating attributes are dropped. The counts are verbatim.

  THE SHOW READ SHORTLIST MAKES. `push`/`or`/`pop` group the two conditions into an OR. On that
  library the grouped read returned 547 shows, exactly the union of `viewedLeafCount!=0` (485) and
  `unwatched=0` (528). The same held for each of ten shared accounts read with their own token. The
  ungrouped form `or=1&viewedLeafCount!=0&unwatched=0` returned 5,953 rows, more than the library's
  5,012 shows, so the brackets matter. `sort=lastViewedAt:desc` is still honoured with the group.

  WHY BOTH HALVES.

    9001 Played Show       a show they played: in both halves.
    9002 Marked Series     marked watched rather than played: episode counts set, NO show
                           `viewCount`/`lastViewedAt`. Missing from `unwatched=0` (issue #108).
    9003 Episodes Removed  watched, then the watched episodes were deleted: the show keeps its
                           `viewCount` and `lastViewedAt`, `viewedLeafCount` is 0. Missing from
                           `viewedLeafCount!=0` (issue #173). 62 of the owner's shows on that server
                           were in this state. In 54 of them every episode now present was added after
                           the show's `lastViewedAt`.

  How each state arises, and what an un-watch does to it: `pms_show_counters_after_deleting_episodes.json`.
-->
